mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of adding a bedroom and bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost is determined by the total square footage, foundation requirements, plumbing proximity, and the quality of interior finishes. Because a bathroom involves water supply lines, waste drainage, electrical circuits, tile work, and ventilation, it costs more per square foot than a dry bedroom space. Connecting to plumbing lines located far from the addition site requires extra trenching and pipe runs, raising labor expenses. Structural roof tie-ins, exterior cladding like full-house stuccoing, and choices between standard fiberglass units versus custom walk-in tile showers also significantly shift the final investment. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms reviews these variables during the estimating process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, plumbing connection distance, foundation work, roof integration, and your choice of finishes like custom tile, vanities, and fixtures.
